prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object approached, Then pick it up, check its properties, and do specific task. Otherwise, move towards object or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = DoSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = MoveTowardsObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO DoSpecificTask
	END
